back_translation: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar.
At that time the army of the king of Babylon was besieging Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet was imprisoned in the courtyard of the guard, which was in the palace of the king of Judah.

For Zedekiah king of Judah had imprisoned him, saying: Why do you prophesy, saying, This is what the LORD says: Behold, I am about to give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he will capture it;

and Zedekiah king of Judah will not escape from the hand of the Chaldeans, but he will surely be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and will speak with him face to face and see him eye to eye;
and he will take Zedekiah to Babylon, and there he will remain until I attend to him, declares the LORD; if you fight against the Chaldeans, you will not succeed?
Jeremiah said: The word of the LORD came to me, saying:
Behold, Hanamel the son of Shallum your uncle is coming to you to say, Buy for yourself my field that is in Anathoth, for the right of redemption to buy it is yours.

Then Hanamel my cousin came to me at the courtyard of the guard, according to the word of the LORD, and said to me, Please buy my field that is in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin, for the right of inheritance and the right of redemption are yours; buy it for yourself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
So I bought the field in Anathoth from Hanamel my cousin, and I weighed out for him the silver, seventeen shekels.
I wrote the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed out the silver on the scales.
Then I took the deed of purchase, the sealed copy with its terms and conditions, and the open copy;

and I gave the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, son of Mahseiah, in the sight of Hanamel my cousin, in the sight of the witnesses who signed the deed of purchase, and in the sight of all the Jews sitting in the courtyard of the guard.
And I instructed Baruch in their sight, saying:

This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Take these deeds, this deed of purchase, both the sealed copy and this open copy, and put them in a clay jar so that they may last a long time.
For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: Houses, fields, and vineyards will again be bought in this land.
After I had given the deed of purchase to Baruch son of Neriah, I prayed to the LORD, saying:
O Lord GOD! Behold, you have made the heavens and the earth by your great power and your outstretched arm; nothing is too hard for you.
You show steadfast love to thousands, but you repay the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them, O great and mighty God—the LORD of Hosts is his name—
great in counsel and mighty in deed, whose eyes watch over all the ways of the sons of men, to give to each according to his ways and according to the fruit of his deeds;
you who performed signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, and still do to this day, both in Israel and among mankind, and you have made for yourself a name, as it is this day.
You brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs and wonders, with a strong hand and an outstretched arm, and with great terror.
You gave them this land, which you swore to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
And they came in and possessed it, but they did not obey your voice or walk in your law; everything you commanded them to do, they did not do; so you have brought upon them all this disaster.

Behold, the siege ramps have come up to the city to capture it, and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it, because of the sword, famine, and plague; what you have spoken has happened, and behold, you see it.
Yet you yourself, O Lord GOD, have said to me, Buy for yourself the field with silver and call witnesses—even though the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah, saying:
Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh; is anything too hard for me?
Therefore this is what the LORD says: Behold, I am about to give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans and into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will capture it.

And the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city will come and set this city on fire and burn it, along with the houses on whose rooftops they burned incense to Baal and poured out drink offerings to other gods, to provoke me to anger.

For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have done only evil in my sight from their youth; indeed, the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger by the work of their hands, declares the LORD.
For this city has aroused my anger and my wrath from the day it was built until this day, so that I will remove it from my presence,

because of all the evil of the children of Israel and the children of Judah that they did to provoke me to anger—they, their kings, their officials, their priests, and their prophets, the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
They turned their backs to me and not their faces; though I taught them again and again, they would not listen to receive discipline.
They set up their abominations in the house that is called by my name, to defile it.

They built the high places of Baal in the Valley of Ben-hinnom, to make their sons and daughters pass through the fire to Molech—which I did not command, and which never entered my mind—to do this abomination, causing Judah to sin.
Now therefore this is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says concerning this city, of which you say, It has been given into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword, famine, and plague:
Behold, I will gather them from all the lands to which I drove them in my anger, my wrath, and great fury, and I will bring them back to this place and make them dwell in safety.
And they will be my people, and I will be their God.
And I will give them one heart and one way, so that they will fear me always, for their own good and for the good of their children after them.
And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn back from doing them good; and I will put my fear in their hearts, so that they will not turn away from me.
And I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will faithfully plant them in this land with all my heart and with all my soul.
For this is what the LORD says: Just as I have brought all this great disaster on this people, so I will bring on them all the good that I have promised them.
And fields will be bought in this land, of which you say, It is a desolation, without man or beast; it has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

People will buy fields with silver, and write deeds, and seal them, and have witnesses, in the land of Benjamin, in the areas around Jerusalem, in the cities of Judah, in the cities of the hill country, in the cities of the Shephelah, and in the cities of the Negev; for I will restore them from captivity, declares the LORD.
